transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in today. What brings you in to see me?

I've been feeling really down and sad almost every day for the past two years, and it just doesn't seem to go away. This persistent low mood is the main reason I decided to come in and seek help today.
Have you also had any periods of at least two months during these two years when you felt back to your usual self, or has the low mood been present most days without a long break?

No, I haven't had any breaks like that at all. This low mood has been present pretty much every single day for the entire two years. I can't remember a time during this whole period where I felt back to my normal self for even a few weeks, let alone two months.

latest_inference.note: Previously the candidates were [Persistent Depressive Disorder, Major Depressive Disorder], but the patient reports depressed mood present almost every day for the past two years with no period of at least two months feeling back to baseline. That chronic course strongly supports Persistent Depressive Disorder and makes Major Depressive Disorder less likely as the primary diagnosis here.
